# Conditional compiler source

`cond_pass.rs` is a byte-exact retained source from the local research pilot.
Its SHA256 is `a56f374ad86c7dd3ca13cfd08291f5f9a4f40a54e122959c481656a54b9d987e`.
The source was frozen with all 14 retained Froghop targets from 25 October 2026.
The retained source path was `runs/frontier-levers-20261025/official/q839-ur/challenge/src/point_add/cond_pass.rs`.
Its public entry point accepts the shared circuit operations and a fixed policy string.

The module comments retain its research authorship and review history.
No separate license grant for this module was present in the retained source closure.
This private repository preserves that source without assigning it a blanket license.
`original-NOTICE` retains the source closure's upstream circuit and simulator credits.
Those credits apply to the files named in that notice.

The caller keeps all four compiler guards active.
The caller rejects diagnostic fault, alignment, and guard-disable environment controls.
